description: Locally sparse travel time tomography (LST) is a tomography algorithm which uses sparse modeling and dictionary learning to estimate 2D geophysical images based on wave travel times across sensor arrays. This repository is an implementation of the IEEE paper: M.J. Bianco and P. Gerstoft, "Travel time tomography with adaptive dictionaries," IEEE Trans. on Computational Imaging, Vol. 4, No. 4, 2018.
